text:
ITEM 1 | Crispy, flat strips of cooked meat with reddish-brown to dark amber color, visible browning and darker crisp edges, slightly glossy with rendered fat, brittle-looking and folded in places, arranged as a cluster of several overlapping strips about 10 cm long and 2 cm wide, sitting center-left on the plate next to the greens | 45

ITEM 2 | Cubed or wedge-cut potato pieces with golden-brown exterior and pale cream interior, some edges crisped and darker brown, matte surface with slight sheen, firm and holding shape, roughly 2-3 cm pieces clustered in the lower-left of the plate | 110

ITEM 3 | Wilted dark green spinach leaves, glossy and slightly limp, with crinkled leaf edges and visible moisture, covering roughly a quarter of the plate in the upper-right, mixed with the carrot shreds | 60

ITEM 4 | Thin julienned orange carrot shreds, bright orange with slightly matte surface, firm and crisp-looking, about 5-6 cm long, scattered over the right side of the spinach | 8
